title: Antonioli.eu Products Scraper
description: Collect structured product data from Antonioli.eu using a product, collection, catalog, or search URL. You can also search by keyword when no URL is supplied.

url.title: URL
url.description: A public Antonioli.eu product, collection, catalog, or search URL. When supplied, it takes priority over the keyword.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Brand, product, or category to search for when no URL is supplied.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of unique products to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum result pages to request. Product URLs use one request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Apify Proxy is used only when the run executes on Apify.
